title: By wheelbarrow or water? 175 years of Co-operation
version: Web page or document as accessed on 9 November 2026
lineage: Institutional historical essay drawing on archives; it questions aspects of traditional origin stories.

passages.note: Members raised subscriptions and loans; the store opened on 21 December 1844. The essay describes equal voting, dividends and education among cooperative principles.
The account gives 28 founders, £10 annual rent, and names John Holt and David Brooks as appointed purchasers.
